prompt.alinti: One developer got so angry at SEO tool pricing that he literally built a free alternative. It hit number one on Product Hunt and has over 19,000 stars on GitHub. It's called OpenSEO, and it does everything that SEMrush charges you $139 for. Keyword research, rank tracking, competitor data, site audits, you name it. But this doesn't just replace SEMrush. It plugs your AI straight into real keyword data. So your strategy runs on actual data. The code is free, and you pay about $0.05 per search. Or if you're not technical, you can just use the website for like $10 a month. Want to use it? Comment 'SEO' down below, and I'll send you the link.
